translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Is'aanaa C'uwayiyaa Miishshaa
«Is'aanaa c'uwayiyaa miishshaa odoorotuwaappe med'd'a;
aw oyddu gas'ay de'o; adusatetsay itti wad'aa, gomppay itti wad'aa, geesay laa"u wad'aa gido; kac'etuukka aanana ittuwaa gidiide oyk'k'etti med'ettino.
Aw bolla doonaa, oyddu bagga ubbaanne Aa kac'etuwaa walakay baynna work'k'aan sheeshsha; Aa yuushshuwaankka work'k'aa tigetsaa yuushsha aatsa.

He work'k'aa tigetsaappe garssanna is'aanaa c'uwayiyaa saas'iniyaw work'k'aappe laa"u sagaayetuwaa med'd'a; yaataade ya baggananne ha baggana laa"uwaa laa"uwaa oytsa. Hewantta tookkiyaa wode kasuwaa aatsanaw maaddanaassa.
Kasotuwaa odoorotuwaappe kessaade, unttuntta work'k'aan sheeshsha.

Ha yarshshiyaa miishshaa K'aalaa C'aak'uwaa Taabootaa sintsan kak'etteedda gaaridduwaappe kare baggana, hewaakka taani neenana gaketiyaa K'aalaa C'aak'uwaa Taabootaa bolla de'iyaa atto giyaa sa'aa k'um"iyaa sintsan wotsa.
«Aaroone wontta wontta s'omppetuwaa giigisanaw yiyaa wode, sawiyaa is'aanaa yarshshiyaa sa'aan c'uwayo.
Aaroone omarssi s'omppetuwaa poo'issiyaa wode, zaaretsiidekka is'aanaa c'uwayo; yaatooppe, is'aanay Med'inaa Godaa sintsan yiyaa yeletaw ubbaade c'uwattana.
Ha is'aanaa c'uwissiyaa miishshaan hara ay is'aananne, woy s'uugiyaa yarshshuwaa, woy katsaa yarshshuwaa yarshshoppa; ushshaa yarshshuwaakka Aa bolla tigoppo.

Aaroone laytsaappe itti gede nagaraappe maarettanaw shukkiyaa mehiyaa suutsaa akkiide, he yarshshiyaa sa'aa bolla de'iyaa kac'etuwaa bolla wotso. Yaatiide geeshshiyaa wogaa polo. Ha wogay sintsanna yaana wodetuwaa ubbaan laytsaan laytsaan poletto. Ha is'aanay c'uwiyaa miishshay Med'inaa Godaw dummati loytsi geeyeeddawaa gido» yaageedda.
Dunkkaaniyaw Shiik'iyaa Miishshaa
Hewaappe guyyiyaan Med'inaa goday Musa hawaadan yaageedda;

«Neeni Israa'eeliyaa asaa payduwaan akkanaw unttuntta paydiyaa wode, itti itti uray paydettiide, bare shemppuwaa wozanaw Med'inaa Godaw shaluwaa c'iggo. Neeni unttuntta paydiyaa wode, unttunttu bolla boshay yeenna.
Payduwaan geliyaa Asay huup'iyaan huup'iyaan Dunkkaaniyaan eretiyaa miizaanaa likkiyaan Biraa c'iggo. Itti itti uray hawaa Med'inaa Godaw imotaa ootsiidde immo.
Payduwaan geliyaa Asay laytsay laatamu kumeeddawenne hewaappe bollaa ubbay, Med'inaa Godaw immiyaawaa aho.
Hinttenttu hinttenttu nagaraappe maarettanaw Med'inaa Godaw imuwaa immishin, duriikka mank'k'uukka itti likkiyaa immanaappe attina, durii darissiide woy mank'k'uu laafetsiidde immoppo.

Nagaraappe maretanaw c'iggiyaa shaluwaa Israa'eeliyaa asaappe akkaade, Med'inaa Godaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddo oosoo peeshsha. Ha shaluu hinttenttu nagaraappe maarettanaw, Med'inaa Godaa sintsan Israa'eeliyaa asaawaa hassayiyaawaa gidanawaa» yaageedda.
Meechchaa Keriyaa
Hewaappe guyyiyaan Med'inaa Goday Musa hawaadan yaageedda;
«Meechchaa keriyaanne Aa wotsiyaawaa nahaasiyaappe med'd'aade S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaappenne yarshshiyaa sa'aappe gidduwaan wotsa; an haatsaa tiga.
Aaroonenne Aa naanay barenttu kushiyaanne barenttu gediyaa meec'ettana.
Unttunttu hayk'k'enna mala, S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa geliyaa wode, awudenne he haatsaan meec'ettino. K'ay Med'inaa Godaw taman yarshshuwaa yarshshanaw yarshshiyaa sa'aa mata shiik'eedda wode,
unttunttu hayk'k'enna mala, barenttu kushiyaanne barenttu gediyaa meec'ettino. Hawe Aaroonawunne Aa zaretoo, yiyaa yeletaa ubbaw med'inaw woga gidanawaa» yaageedda.
Okettiyaa Zayitiyaa
Med'inaa Goday Musa hawaadan yaageedda;
«Muruta k'imaametuwaa, hewanttukka, usuppun kiilo giraame gukkiyaa karbbiyaa, heezzu kiilo giraame sawiyaa k'arafaa, heezzu kiilo giraame sawiyaa gunc'echchaanne
usuppun kiilo giraame zimbbaanuwaa akka. Ha ubbaykka Dunkkaaniyaan eretiyaa miizaanaa likkiyaan gido. Hewaa bollakka oyddu liitiro Wogaraa zayitiyaa gujja.
Hawantta shittuwaa ootsiyaa eran walakkaade, sawiyaa geeshsha okkiyaa zayite kessa.
Yaataade S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa, K'aalaa c'aak'uwaa Taabootaa,
s'arp'p'eezaanne Aa bolla wotsiyaa miishshaa ubbaa, s'omppiyaa wotsiyaa ballanne Aa miishshatuwaa, is'aanaa c'uwayiyaa miishshaa,
s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa yarshshiyaa sa'aanne an de'iyaa ubbaa miishshatuwaa, meechchaa keriyaanne Aa wotsiyaawaa okka.
Unttunttu loytsi geeshsha gidana mala, neeni unttuntta dummaya; unttuntta bochchiyaawe ubbaykka geeshsha gidanawaa.
«Hewaappe guyyiyaan Aaroonenne Aa naanay k'eesatuwaa gidiide taw ootsana mala, unttuntta okkaadde dummaya;
Israa'eeliyaa asaw hawaadan yaagaadde oda; ‹Hawe yiyaa yeletawukka okettiyaa ta geeshsha zayite gido;
ha zayitiyaa asaa bollan gussoppa; k'ay ay zayitiikka hewaa ootseedda likkiyaan ootsoppa. I geeshsha gideedda diraw, hinttenttukka Aa geeshshabaadan k'oppite.
Hawaa mala shittuwaa giigissiyaa uraynne k'eesatuwaa gidenna hara asaa okkiyaa uray ooninne bare asaa giddoppe bohetto› yaaga» yaageedda.
Is'aanaabaa

Hewaappe guyye Med'inaa Goday Musa hawaadan yaageedda; «Sawiyaa k'imaametuwaa: mitsaa c'ooshshaa, d'aad'd'iyaa gollen de'iyaa shittuwaa, sawiyaa shidiyaanne sawiyaa geeshsha is'aanaa akka; unttunttu ubbaa dees'uukka itti likke gido.
Shittuwaadan walaketteedda is'aanaa ootsaade, unttunttun go'etta; walakay baynnawaanne geeshsha gidanaadan, an mas'iniyaa yegga.
Aappe amareedawaa akkaade liik'issaade c'adda; yaataade taani neenana gaketiyaa S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa giddon K'aalaa c'aak'uwaa Taabootaa sintsan wotsa. I new loytsi geeshsha gidanawaa.
Hawaa med'd'eeddawaa likkiyaan hara is'aanaa med'd'oppite. Hewe Med'inaa Godaw dumma geeshsha gidiyaawaa erite.
Hawaa malatiyaawaa med'd'iide, Aa sawuwaa singgiide nashettanaw koyiyaa uray de'ooppe, I bare asaa giddoppe bohetto» yaageedda.
